title: 1787 New Spain earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1787 New Spain earthquake", at revision 1372294366, opens: "The 1787 New Spain earthquake, also known as the San Sixto earthquake, occurred on 28 March at 11:30 local time. It caused a large tsunami that affected the coast of the Puebla Intendancy and the Oaxaca Intendancy in Southwestern New Spain. With an estimated magnitude of Mw 8.6, it is Mexico's most powerful instrumentally recorded earthquake." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q20312101, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "earthquake". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
